q: A company wants to make sure its cloud workloads are run at agreed service levels, with mature monitoring, incident and problem management, and capacity planning. Which AWS CAF perspective covers this?

An IAM user is in a group whose policy allows s3:*. A policy attached directly to the user explicitly denies s3:DeleteObject on bucket 'reports'. What happens when the user tries to delete an object in 'reports'?
answer: Denied, because an explicit deny overrides any allow
lastPicked: Allowed, because the most permissive policy wins

q: A company must continuously check whether all EBS volumes are encrypted, keep a history of resource configuration changes, and fix noncompliant resources automatically. Which service should it use?

Auditors in a central security account need read-only access to resources in 20 member accounts of an AWS Organization. The company does not want to create IAM users in each account. What is the recommended approach?
answer: Create an IAM role in each member account that trusts the security account, and have auditors assume it through AWS STS
lastPicked: Add resource-based policies to every S3 bucket
